passages.text: Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
Kish was a man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Kish was the son of Abiel.
Abiel was the son of Zeror.
Zeror was the son of Becorath.
Becorath was the son of Aphiah.
Aphiah was a man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Kish was a powerful man.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ אִ֣ישׁ מִבִּן־ יָמִין וּ֠שְׁמוֹ קִ֣ישׁ בֶּן־ אֲבִיאֵ֞ל בֶּן־ צְר֧וֹר בֶּן־ בְּכוֹרַ֛ת בֶּן־ אֲפִ֖יחַ בֶּן־ אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינִ֑י גִּבּ֖וֹר חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: And he had a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites—a head taller than any of the people.
passages.sermon:
Kish was a powerful man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Kish had a son named Saul.
Saul was a young man.
Saul was handsome.
No one in Israel was more handsome than Saul.
Saul was taller than all the people.
Saul stood a head above everyone else.
passages.original: וְלוֹ־ הָיָ֨ה בֵ֜ן וּשְׁמ֤וֹ שָׁאוּל֙ בָּח֣וּר וָט֔וֹב וְאֵ֥ין אִ֛ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ט֣וֹב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מִשִּׁכְמ֣וֹ וָמַ֔עְלָה גָּבֹ֖הַּ מִכָּל־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: One day the donkeys of Saul’s father Kish wandered off, and Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.”
passages.sermon:
Kish was a powerful man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Kish was the father of Saul.
One day, the donkeys of Kish wandered off.
Kish spoke to his son Saul.
Kish said, “Take one of the servants with you.”
Kish said, “Get up and go look for the donkeys.”
passages.original: וַתֹּאבַ֙דְנָה֙ הָאֲתֹנ֔וֹת לְקִ֖ישׁ אֲבִ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר קִ֜ישׁ אֶל־ שָׁא֣וּל בְּנ֗וֹ קַח־ נָ֤א אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ אַחַ֣ד מֵֽהַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְק֣וּם לֵ֔ךְ בַּקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־ הָאֲתֹנֹֽת׃

passages.text: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah, but did not find the donkeys. He and the servant went through the region of Shaalim, but they were not there. Then they went through the land of Benjamin, and still they did not find them.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the son of Kish.
Saul was searching for his father's lost donkeys.
Saul took a servant with him.
Saul went through the hill country of Ephraim.
He did not find the donkeys there.
Saul went through the land of Shalishah.
He did not find the donkeys there.
Saul and the servant went through the region of Shaalim.
The donkeys were not there.
Saul went through the land of Benjamin.
He did not find the donkeys there.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר בְּהַר־ אֶפְרַ֛יִם וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ שָׁלִ֖שָׁה וְלֹ֣א מָצָ֑אוּ וַיַּעַבְר֤וּ בְאֶֽרֶץ־ שַׁעֲלִים֙ וָאַ֔יִן וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ יְמִינִ֖י וְלֹ֥א מָצָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: When they reached the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant, “Come, let us go back, or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.”
passages.sermon:
Saul was the son of Kish.
Kish was Saul’s father.
Saul and his servant traveled together.
They reached the land of Zuph.
Saul spoke to his servant.
Saul said, “Let us return.”
Saul explained his reason.
He said, “My father may stop worrying about the donkeys.”
He said, “My father may begin to worry about us.”
passages.original: הֵ֗מָּה בָּ֚אוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ צ֔וּף וְשָׁא֥וּל אָמַ֛ר לְנַעֲר֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּ֖וֹ לְכָ֣ה וְנָשׁ֑וּבָה פֶּן־ יֶחְדַּ֥ל אָבִ֛י מִן־ הָאֲתֹנ֖וֹת וְדָ֥אַג לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: “Look,” said the servant, “in this city there is a man of God who is highly respected; everything he says surely comes to pass. Let us go there now. Perhaps he will tell us which way to go.”
passages.sermon:
The servant spoke to Saul.
He said, “Look, there is a man of God in this city.
This man is highly respected.
Everything he says comes true.
Let us go to him now.
Perhaps he will tell us the way we should go.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הִנֵּה־ נָ֤א אִישׁ־ אֱלֹהִים֙ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְהָאִ֣ישׁ נִכְבָּ֔ד כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יְדַבֵּ֖ר בּ֣וֹא יָב֑וֹא עַתָּה֙ נֵ֣לֲכָה שָּׁ֔ם אוּלַי֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔נוּ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּ֖נוּ אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֥כְנוּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: “If we do go,” Saul replied, “what can we give the man? For the bread in our packs is gone, and there is no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?”
passages.sermon:
Saul spoke to his servant.
Saul and his servant were looking for lost donkeys.
They wanted to visit a man of God in the city.
Saul said, “If we go, what can we give the man?”
He said, “The bread in our packs is gone.”
He said, “We have no gift to bring to the man of God.”
He asked, “What do we have?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל לְנַעֲר֗וֹ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נֵלֵךְ֮ וּמַה־ נָּבִ֣יא לָאִישׁ֒ כִּ֤י הַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ אָזַ֣ל מִכֵּלֵ֔ינוּ וּתְשׁוּרָ֥ה אֵין־ לְהָבִ֖יא לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים מָ֖ה אִתָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: The servant answered him again. “Look,” he said, “I have here in my hand a quarter shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God, and he will tell us our way.”
passages.sermon:
The servant spoke to Saul again.
The servant said, “Look, I have a quarter shekel of silver in my hand.
I will give this silver to the man of God.
The man of God is a prophet.
He will tell us which way to go.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤סֶף הַנַּ֙עַר֙ לַעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת־ שָׁא֔וּל וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה֙ נִמְצָ֣א בְיָדִ֔י רֶ֖בַע שֶׁ֣קֶל כָּ֑סֶף וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהִגִּ֥יד לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: (Formerly in Israel, a man on his way to inquire of God would say, “Come, let us go to the seer.” For the prophet of today was formerly called the seer.)
passages.sermon:
In the past, people lived in Israel.
A man wanted to ask God for guidance.
He would speak to others.
He would say, “Come, let us go to the seer.”
Today, people call this person a prophet.
In the past, people called him a seer.
passages.original: לְפָנִ֣ים׀ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר הָאִישׁ֙ בְּלֶכְתּוֹ֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְכ֥וּ וְנֵלְכָ֖ה עַד־ הָרֹאֶ֑ה כִּ֤י לַנָּבִיא֙ הַיּ֔וֹם יִקָּרֵ֥א לְפָנִ֖ים הָרֹאֶֽה׃

passages.text: “Good,” said Saul to his servant. “Come, let us go.” So they set out for the city where the man of God was.
passages.sermon:
Saul was a man from Israel.
Saul spoke to his servant.
Saul said, “Your idea is good.”
Saul said, “Come, let us go.”
Saul and his servant went to the city.
The man of God was in that city.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֧וּל לְנַעֲר֛וֹ ט֥וֹב דְּבָרְךָ֖ לְכָ֣ה׀ נֵלֵ֑כָה וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: And as they were climbing the hill to the city, they met some young women coming out to draw water and asked, “Is the seer here?”
passages.sermon:
Saul and his servant climbed the hill to the city.
They met some young women.
The young women were coming out to draw water.
Saul and his servant spoke to the young women.
They asked the young women, “Is the seer here?”
passages.original: הֵ֗מָּה עֹלִים֙ בְּמַעֲלֵ֣ה הָעִ֔יר וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ מָצְא֣וּ נְעָר֔וֹת יֹצְא֖וֹת לִשְׁאֹ֣ב מָ֑יִם וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָהֶ֔ן הֲיֵ֥שׁ בָּזֶ֖ה הָרֹאֶֽה׃

passages.text: “Yes, he is ahead of you,” they answered. “Hurry now, for today he has come to the city because the people have a sacrifice on the high place.
passages.sermon:
Some young women met Saul and his servant.
The women answered Saul and his servant.
They said, “Yes, the seer is here.”
They said, “He is ahead of you.”
They said, “Hurry now.”
They said, “Today he has come to the city.”
They said, “The people have a sacrifice today.”
They said, “The sacrifice is on the high place.”
passages.original: וַתַּעֲנֶ֧ינָה אוֹתָ֛ם וַתֹּאמַ֥רְנָה יֵּ֖שׁ הִנֵּ֣ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַהֵ֣ר׀ עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֤י הַיּוֹם֙ בָּ֣א לָעִ֔יר כִּ֣י זֶ֧בַח הַיּ֛וֹם לָעָ֖ם בַּבָּמָֽה׃

passages.text: As soon as you enter the city, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not eat until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; after that, the guests will eat. Go up at once; you will find him.”
passages.sermon:
You will enter the city.
You will find the seer there.
You will see him before he goes up to the high place to eat.
The people will not eat until he arrives.
He must bless the sacrifice first.
After he blesses the sacrifice, the invited guests will eat.
Go up now.
You will find him today.
passages.original: כְּבֹאֲכֶ֣ם הָעִ֣יר כֵּ֣ן תִּמְצְא֣וּן אֹת֡וֹ בְּטֶרֶם֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה הַבָּמָ֜תָה לֶאֱכֹ֗ל כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ יֹאכַ֤ל הָעָם֙ עַד־ בֹּא֔וֹ כִּֽי־ הוּא֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ הַזֶּ֔בַח אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יֹאכְל֣וּ הַקְּרֻאִ֑ים וְעַתָּ֣ה עֲל֔וּ כִּֽי־ אֹת֥וֹ כְהַיּ֖וֹם תִּמְצְא֥וּן אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Saul and his servant went up toward the city, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel coming toward them on his way up to the high place.
passages.sermon:
Saul was a young man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Saul had a servant with him.
Saul and his servant went up toward the city.
They entered the city together.
Samuel was a prophet of God.
Samuel came out to meet them.
Samuel was on his way up to the high place.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ הָעִ֑יר הֵ֗מָּה בָּאִים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׁמוּאֵל֙ יֹצֵ֣א לִקְרָאתָ֔ם לַעֲל֖וֹת הַבָּמָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Now on the day before Saul’s arrival, the LORD had revealed to Samuel, “At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you are to anoint him leader over My people Israel; he will save them from the hand of the Philistines. For I have looked upon My people, because their cry has come to Me.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Samuel.
This happened one day before Saul arrived.
The LORD revealed a message to Samuel.
The LORD said, “At this time tomorrow, I will send you a man.
This man will come from the land of Benjamin.
You must anoint him as leader over My people Israel.
He will save My people from the hand of the Philistines.
I have seen My people.
Their cry has come to Me.”
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה אֶת־ אֹ֣זֶן שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד לִפְנֵ֥י בֽוֹא־ שָׁא֖וּל לֵאמֹֽר׃ כָּעֵ֣ת׀ מָחָ֡ר אֶשְׁלַח֩ אֵלֶ֨יךָ אִ֜ישׁ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וּמְשַׁחְתּ֤וֹ לְנָגִיד֙ עַל־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י מִיַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים כִּ֤י רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י כִּ֛י בָּ֥אָה צַעֲקָת֖וֹ אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD told him, “Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of God.
Saul was a man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Samuel saw Saul.
The LORD spoke to Samuel.
The LORD said, “This is the man I told you about.”
The LORD said, “He will rule over My people.”
passages.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל רָאָ֣ה אֶת־ שָׁא֑וּל וַיהוָ֣ה עָנָ֔הוּ הִנֵּ֤ה הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔יךָ זֶ֖ה יַעְצֹ֥ר בְּעַמִּֽי׃

passages.text: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”
passages.sermon:
Saul was a man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Samuel was a prophet and a seer in Israel.
Saul came near to Samuel at the gateway.
Saul spoke to Samuel.
Saul said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”
passages.original: וַיִּגַּ֥שׁ שָׁא֛וּל אֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בְּת֣וֹךְ הַשָּׁ֑עַר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַגִּֽידָה־ נָּ֣א לִ֔י אֵי־ זֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית הָרֹאֶֽה׃

passages.text: “I am the seer,” Samuel replied. “Go up before me to the high place, for you shall eat with me today. And when I send you off in the morning, I will tell you all that is in your heart.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and a seer in Israel.
Samuel answered Saul.
Samuel said, “I am the seer.
Go up before me to the high place.
You will eat with me today.
In the morning, I will send you away.
I will tell you everything that is in your heart.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַן שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת־ שָׁא֗וּל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אָנֹכִ֣י הָרֹאֶ֔ה עֲלֵ֤ה לְפָנַי֙ הַבָּמָ֔ה וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣יךָ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ אַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them, for they have been found. And upon whom is all the desire of Israel, if not upon you and all your father’s house?”
passages.sermon:
Samuel spoke to Saul.
Samuel was a prophet and seer in Israel.
Saul had lost his donkeys three days ago.
Samuel said, “Do not worry about the donkeys.
The donkeys have been found.
All the desire of Israel is now upon you.
All the desire of Israel is also upon your father’s house.”
passages.original: וְלָאֲתֹנ֞וֹת הָאֹבְד֣וֹת לְךָ֗ הַיּוֹם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֔ים אַל־ תָּ֧שֶׂם אֶֽת־ לִבְּךָ֛ לָהֶ֖ם כִּ֣י נִמְצָ֑אוּ וּלְמִי֙ כָּל־ חֶמְדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲל֣וֹא לְךָ֔ וּלְכֹ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיךָ׃ס

passages.text: Saul replied, “Am I not a Benjamite from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of Benjamin? So why would you say such a thing to me?”
passages.sermon:
Saul spoke.
Saul replied to Samuel.
Saul was a Benjamite.
The tribe of Benjamin was the smallest tribe in Israel.
Saul’s clan was the least important among all the clans of Benjamin.
Saul asked Samuel, “Why do you speak to me like this?”
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַן שָׁא֜וּל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲל֨וֹא בֶן־ יְמִינִ֤י אָ֙נֹכִי֙ מִקַּטַנֵּי֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִשְׁפַּחְתִּי֙ הַצְּעִרָ֔ה מִכָּֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת שִׁבְטֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וְלָ֙מָּה֙ דִּבַּ֣רְתָּ אֵלַ֔י כַּדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant, brought them into the hall, and seated them in the place of honor among those who were invited—about thirty in all.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and leader in Israel.
Saul was the son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin.
Saul had a servant with him.
Samuel took Saul and his servant.
Samuel brought them into the hall.
Samuel gave them a place at the head of those who were invited.
About thirty people were invited.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־ שָׁא֣וּל וְאֶֽת־ נַעֲר֔וֹ וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם לִשְׁכָּ֑תָה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַקְּרוּאִ֔ים וְהֵ֖מָּה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion I gave you and told you to set aside.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and leader in Israel.
Samuel spoke to the cook.
Samuel said, “Bring the portion I gave you.
I told you to set it aside.
Now bring it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ לַטַּבָּ֔ח תְּנָה֙ אֶת־ הַמָּנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָ֑ךְ אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔יךָ שִׂ֥ים אֹתָ֖הּ עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: So the cook picked up the leg and what was attached to it and set it before Saul. Then Samuel said, “Here is what was kept back. It was set apart for you. Eat, for it has been kept for you for this occasion, from the time I said, ‘I have invited the people.’ ” So Saul dined with Samuel that day.
passages.sermon:
The cook picked up the leg and what was attached to it.
The cook set it before Saul.
Samuel spoke to Saul.
Samuel said, “This is what was kept back.
This portion was set apart for you.
Eat it.
It was kept for you for this special occasion.
I said, ‘I have invited the people.’
From that time, this portion was reserved for you.”
Saul ate with Samuel on that day.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣רֶם הַ֠טַּבָּח אֶת־ הַשּׁ֨וֹק וְהֶעָלֶ֜יהָ וַיָּ֣שֶׂם׀ לִפְנֵ֣י שָׁא֗וּל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנֵּ֤ה הַנִּשְׁאָר֙ שִׂים־ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֱכֹ֔ל כִּ֧י לַמּוֹעֵ֛ד שָֽׁמוּר־ לְךָ֥ לֵאמֹ֖ר הָעָ֣ם׀ קָרָ֑אתִי וַיֹּ֧אכַל שָׁא֛וּל עִם־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

passages.text: And after they had come down from the high place into the city, Samuel spoke with Saul on the roof of his house.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of God.
Saul was a young man from the tribe of Benjamin.
Samuel and Saul came down from the high place.
They entered the city.
Samuel spoke with Saul.
They were on the roof of Samuel’s house.
passages.original: וַיֵּרְד֥וּ מֵהַבָּמָ֖ה הָעִ֑יר וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר עִם־ שָׁא֖וּל עַל־ הַגָּֽג׃

passages.text: They got up early in the morning, and just before dawn Samuel called to Saul on the roof, “Get ready, and I will send you on your way!” So Saul arose, and both he and Samuel went outside together.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of God.
Saul was a young man chosen by God.
They stayed together that night.
They got up early in the morning.
It was just before dawn.
Samuel called to Saul.
Saul was on the roof.
Samuel said, “Get ready.”
Samuel said, “I will send you on your way.”
Saul got up.
Saul and Samuel went outside together.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֗מוּ וַיְהִ֞י כַּעֲל֤וֹת הַשַּׁ֙חַר֙ וַיִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־ שָׁאוּל֙ הַגָּג לֵאמֹ֔ר ק֖וּמָה וַאֲשַׁלְּחֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּ֣קָם שָׁא֗וּל וַיֵּצְא֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם ה֥וּא וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַחֽוּצָה׃

passages.text: As they were going down to the edge of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us, but you stay for a while, and I will reveal to you the word of God.” So the servant went on.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of God.
Saul was with Samuel.
They were going down to the edge of the city.
Samuel spoke to Saul.
Samuel said, "Tell the servant to go on ahead of us."
Saul told the servant to go ahead.
The servant went ahead.
Samuel said to Saul, "You stay here for a while."
Samuel said, "I will tell you the word of God."
passages.original: הֵ֗מָּה יֽוֹרְדִים֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הָעִ֔יר וּשְׁמוּאֵ֞ל אָמַ֣ר אֶל־ שָׁא֗וּל אֱמֹ֥ר לַנַּ֛עַר וְיַעֲבֹ֥ר לְפָנֵ֖ינוּ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַתָּה֙ עֲמֹ֣ד כַּיּ֔וֹם וְאַשְׁמִיעֲךָ֖ אֶת־ דְּבַ֥ר אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
